title: AutoGraph could not transform function
body:
I have tried to reproduce https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/function , and got a "Please report this to the TensorFlow team." message:

```
#!/usr/bin/env python
from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function, unicode_literals
import tensorflow as tf
import os
assert os.getenv("AUTOGRAPH_VERBOSITY") == "10"
@tf.function
def add(a, b):
  return a + b
add(tf.ones([2, 2]), tf.ones([2, 2]))
```
